substeps.caption: EVAC/AIR vents the chamber; the door is pulled straight out by its handle, the stage on its inside face.
The polished mount, on a holder set to height at the bench, drops into the socket in the stage.

Door in, EVAC/AIR again: about three minutes to vacuum. The EDS detector is built in, its analyser beside. EBSD (left) is a proposal: no TM4000 option exists, and it needs a 70 degree pre-tilted holder.
